No, I can't tell whether your heart rate stayed elevated all day on October 2, 2026. The local data only covers a three-minute window that morning.

- **What's there:** Three heart rate readings, at 10:00, 10:01 and 10:02 AM, of 100, 101 and 102 bpm.
- **Why that's not enough:** The provider only returned heart rate for exercise windows, not the whole day. Those readings probably came from a workout, so they don't show what your heart rate did at other times.
- **What's missing:** No readings exist for the rest of the day, so I can't say whether it stayed elevated. A missing reading isn't the same as a normal one.

To check the full day, I can re-import Google heart rate with the whole-day option turned on. That pulls about 37 MB per day of history, so it's a large download. Do you want me to do that?

If you're concerned about your heart rate, a clinician is the right person to ask.
